nodes.description: Private constant bytes32 guard sentinel value (keccak256("guard.bytes32")) used to initialize the guard state variable.
Address state variable holding the library contract targeted by the delegatecall inside batchLogs; set once in the constructor.
bytes32 guard state variable; initialized to GUARD_VALUE in the constructor, making require(guard != GUARD_VALUE) in batchLogs always revert.
Public mapping(address => UnlockSchedule[]) storing per-beneficiary unlock schedules; never written or read by any function.
Constructor: stores _gatedLogBatcherLib into gatedLogBatcherLib and sets guard = GUARD_VALUE.
Public function that checks guard and delegatecalls multiSend(bytes) on gatedLogBatcherLib, then emits BatchLogs.
Caller of the public batchLogs function; no access control restricts who may invoke it.
delegatecall into gatedLogBatcherLib with abi.encodeWithSignature("multiSend(bytes)", logs); executes untrusted external code in this contract's storage context and return value is ignored.
Arbitrary calldata bytes parameter of batchLogs, ABI-encoded and forwarded to the delegatecall target.
Constructor parameter _gatedLogBatcherLib, the address assigned to the gatedLogBatcherLib state variable.
Local bool capturing the delegatecall success flag, which is never checked.
Local bytes capturing the delegatecall return data, which is never decoded or validated.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _gatedLogBatcherLib flows into the constructor body.
Constructor writes the parameter value into the gatedLogBatcherLib state variable.
Constant GUARD_VALUE is assigned to guard, making the batchLogs guard check always fail.
Constructor initializes the guard state variable at deployment time.
batchLogs reads guard in require(guard != GUARD_VALUE); because it is initialized to GUARD_VALUE the intended gate is broken (always reverts / useless guard).
batchLogs is public and reachable by any msg.sender with no effective access control, enabling unauthorized invocation.
The mutable gatedLogBatcherLib address is the delegatecall target; a compromised or malicious target executes arbitrary code in this contract's context.
batchLogs unconditionally executes the delegatecall unsafe operation on the externally controlled library address.
The attacker-supplied logs parameter is ABI-encoded and passed directly into the delegatecall payload.
delegatecall returns its success flag into the unchecked local variable success.
delegatecall returns raw returndata into the unused local variable data.
The delegatecall executes external code with this contract's storage; the callee can re-enter batchLogs or mutate guard/gatedLogBatcherLib while the guard is ineffective.

normalization_plan.reason: The logs parameter is only used as the ABI-encoded payload of the delegatecall unsafe operation, so it should be merged into that core node.
The constructor parameter _gatedLogBatcherLib is only used to initialize state from the constructor function, so it should be merged into the constructor core node.
The local success flag is only the ignored return value of the delegatecall unsafe operation, so it should be merged into that core node.
The local data buffer is only the unused returndata of the delegatecall unsafe operation, so it should be merged into that core node.
